# GroupDocs.Search.Mcp.Tests

Integration tests and how-to guides for the GroupDocs.Search MCP server (ghcr.io/groupdocs-search/search-net-mcp), which indexes local documents and runs full-text search for AI agents. The suite launches the published container image (or a local build), connects as an MCP stdio client, and drives every tool: create_index, add_to_index, update_index, remove_from_index, search, get_text_fragments, get_index_info, get_license_status.

## Run

- Against the image: `MCP_SERVER_IMAGE=ghcr.io/groupdocs-search/search-net-mcp:26.10.1 dotnet test --filter "Category!=Metered"`
- Against a local build: `MCP_SERVER_DLL=<path>/GroupDocs.Search.Mcp.dll dotnet test --filter "Category!=Metered"`
- Metered licensing (spends real credit; needs GROUPDOCS_METERED_PUBLIC_KEY and GROUPDOCS_METERED_PRIVATE_KEY): `--filter "Category=Metered"`

## What is covered

- Tool discovery: exactly 8 tools, descriptions, schemas, phrase-quoting guidance in search.
- Search: single word, OR, AND, quoted phrase, unquoted-phrase hint, empty result, DOCX/PDF/TXT samples, evaluation note.
- Index lifecycle: add, info, update after edit and delete, remove file and folder, create and recreate, text fragments, index folder never indexed.
- Errors: isError true plus the promised text for unknown index, missing path, path escape, absolute path, path as index name, file-inside-folder removal, empty and missing query.
- Metered: mode metered, no evaluation note, consumption never decreases, keys never echoed.

## Distribution note

GroupDocs.Search.Mcp is Docker-first: the packed .NET tool (~281 MiB) exceeds NuGet.org's 250 MB limit, so there is no dnx channel. CI's docker job runs the suite; the 3-OS dnx job only compiles.
